DemoClarify: How will you use this text? (Offline demo)
KeyboardUnavailable: Could not open the Windows on-screen keyboard. Record again, or open it from Windows Accessibility.
TargetTimeout: The target field is responding too slowly. Automatic insertion stopped; recording and cancellation remain available. Copy manually.
ClipboardChanged: New clipboard content was detected. Insertion stopped without replacing your new copy.
ReleaseModifiers: Release Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Windows keys before inserting.
InputTooLong: Text exceeds the size limit. Shorten it and try again.
PreferencesCorrupt: Local preferences could not be read and will not be used.
TargetHint: Click an input field, then the floating microphone. To choose again, click the field and then the floating checkmark. There is no time limit.
TargetNone: No verified input field · You can still copy
TargetCaptured: Target recorded again. Return here to confirm insertion.
ClipboardNotice: Insertion uses clipboard paste, without Enter. The previous clipboard is restored only when safe. Clipboard history, cloud sync or other tools may retain text.
Privacy: The microphone runs only after you click Record. Audio goes to your configured speech service; transcription and a few allowed preferences go to your configured text service. This app does not read the screen, websites, other chats or browsing history. For safe insertion it checks the target field, its content and selection locally, without sending them. Audio and full history are not saved by default.
ApiKey: API key (leave empty to keep saved key)
TestStt: Test speech (sends a short silent WAV)
TestLlm: Test text (sends a tiny test request)
TestPassed: Connection passed. Chinese recognition quality has not been verified.
NoMic: No microphone found. Try the demo sample first.
TranscribeOnly: Transcribe only, skip text model (also in Original mode)
SummaryUnavailable: This version transcribes after stopping. Live summaries are unavailable and make no additional model requests.
Learn: Learn writing habits (only punctuation and length from text confirmed here)
PrefHint: Save writing style only, without names, accounts or sensitive data. Your current instructions take priority.
Terms: Common terms (saved explicitly, never extracted automatically)
NonStreaming: Listening · Text is generated after stopping
DemoNotice: Demo notice: services marked Demo use simulated content. This does not verify recognition or AI quality. Other configured real services may still make billable requests.
ManualHint: You can edit the transcription and choose Rewrite again. Review every result. This app never searches, sends messages or executes tasks.
Inserted: Text inserted. Check the target window; nothing was submitted.
Copied: Copied. Paste into the intended field yourself.
RecordingFailed: Could not start recording. Check the microphone and Windows desktop-app microphone permission.
AudioEmpty: No audio received. Check the microphone and try again.
Suspend: Computer suspended or session locked. This task was cancelled.
Busy: Stop or cancel the current task first.
Unknown: The action did not finish. Text is preserved; check settings and try again.
TargetMissing: The target closed or has not been selected. Choose it again or copy.
TargetChanged: The target, caret, selection or content changed. Choose again or copy to avoid typing in the wrong place.
TargetUnsafe: Passwords, terminals and other high-risk targets support manual copy only.
TargetUnsupported: The field or insertion location cannot be verified. Copy manually.
TargetPermission: The target is elevated or inaccessible. This app will not bypass permissions.
ClipboardBusy: The clipboard is busy. Text is preserved; copy manually later.
ClipboardUnsupported: The entire clipboard cannot be preserved. Only manual copy is offered.
InsertUncertain: Insertion could not be confirmed. Check the target before trying again.
InvalidConfiguration: Invalid configuration. Check the HTTPS URL, model and timeout.
InvalidKey: API key is missing or invalid. Replace it in Settings.
Unauthorized: Invalid API key or insufficient permission.
RateLimited: Rate limit or insufficient balance. No automatic retry was made.
InsufficientQuota: Insufficient balance or quota. No automatic retry was made.
TimeoutError: Request timed out. No automatic retry was made. Check the service before rewriting again.
Network: Network request failed. No automatic retry was made.
ModelNotFound: Model or endpoint not found. Check configuration.
UnsupportedFormat: The service does not support this audio or response format.
InvalidResponse: The response did not match the supported protocol and was not accepted.
TooLarge: Input or response exceeds the app's size limit.
Server: Service unavailable. No automatic retry was made.
EmptyTranscript: No text was recognized. Record again or edit the transcription.
SecretError: Windows could not read or save the encrypted key. Configure it again.
ConfigCorrupt: Configuration could not be read. Safe defaults were loaded.
HelpText:
1. Click a target field, then the floating microphone.
2. Stop recording and review the original and prepared text.
3. Choose the purpose if asked, then confirm insertion or copy.
Choose the target again after any change. Check uncertain insertion before retrying.
Recordings stop at 120 seconds. Requests do not retry automatically. No idle listening or automatic submission.
Implemented real protocols: non-streaming WAV transcription and text Chat Completions JSON. Other protocols are not implemented.
SelectTargetInstructions: Click the target input field, then click the checkmark on the floating icon to confirm it. This does not start recording.
